makeToolLinks.capability: Generic OBD-II powertrain-code reading for canonical generic P-family DTCs.
makeToolLinks.restriction: Does not establish manufacturer-specific, body, chassis, network, hybrid/EV, or exact-vehicle compatibility.

makeToolLinks.capability: Cooling-system pressure testing through supplied hose and cap adapters.
makeToolLinks.restriction: Owner must confirm an included adapter matches the vehicle before buying.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: Smoke testing for EVAP, vacuum, intake, exhaust and turbo/boost leaks, with a dedicated 0-1 psi EVAP mode.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Only shown when the How-to-Fix explicitly prescribes a smoke test.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: Battery state of health, CCA and internal-resistance analysis.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Not a true resistive battery load tester; load-test wording is an unresolved-tool hold.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: Low-current DC clamp measurement for explicit parasitic-draw procedures.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Not inferred from a parasitic-drain symptom alone.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: AC/DC voltage and current, resistance, continuity, capacitance, frequency and diode tests.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Not a waveform scope and not inferred when the article does not explicitly prescribe a multimeter.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: 0-300 psi compression testing on gasoline engines with 10, 12, 14 and 18 mm adapters.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Requires explicitly proven gasoline-engine context; suppressed for diesel, EV and unknown engine context.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: Mechanical engine/transmission oil-pressure testing with 0-100 psi and 0-400 psi gauges and 13 adapters.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Owner must confirm the correct engine-port adapter and factory pressure specification.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: 0-100 psi fuel-system pressure testing with a relief valve and brass fittings.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Requires proven compatible low-pressure gasoline application; suppressed for diesel, direct-injection high-pressure rail, flex-fuel and unknown engine context.

reusableReviewedTools.capability: Licensed VCDS interface for diagnostic-capable Volkswagen/Audi Group passenger cars, including manufacturer-specific control-module diagnostics.
reusableReviewedTools.restriction: Limited to supported VAG vehicles and VIN count; 1990-1994 applications require separate legacy/adapter review, and hybrid/EV coverage remains fail-closed here.

holds.excerpt: Perform a TCM adaptation reset via scan tool.
If the engine has overheated, perform a combustion-gas (block) test;
Always perform the ECU/throttle re-learn procedure after battery disconnection or TBI replacement (key-on relearn or scanner-guided throttle adaptation).
Outside the recall scope, test charging output (~14 V at idle) and replace or rebuild a failing alternator;
relearn/calibration via diagnostic tool fixes some complaints.
Persistent clunking or limp mode requires valve-body/mechatronic diagnosis;
Have the battery load-tested and replaced with a correct-spec (or higher-capacity) AGM/EFB unit if weak, since most start-stop and module misbehavior traces back to low voltage;
Never keep driving with the temperature gauge climbing — head gasket damage costs many times more than the housing.
For chronic faults: scan the TCU for stored codes first;
For non-recall cars with hard-start or stalling symptoms, have the fuel pump pressure, pump relay and the pump ground terminal connections tested before replacing the pump.
Have the battery's state of health and charge tested with proper equipment.
